resolution_notes: base_url: Set to https://bitpay.com; the Environments page identifies it as the production base URL (https://developer.bitpay.com/reference/environments). auth_type: Set to other because BitPay uses facade API tokens and BitAuth rather than X-Api-Key (https://developer.bitpay.com/reference/concepts). example: Replaced /api/v2 and X-Api-Key with /invoices/{invoiceId}, the token query parameter, and X-Accept-Version 2.0.0 (https://developer.bitpay.com/reference/retrieve-an-invoice).
